messages:
Mai: FYI i noticed several tenants seeing negative 'unit cost' in the cost dashboard after cache/prefetch credits land. this is confusing to PMs. :confused:
Jordan: saw that too. /chat/complete had negative 95p for a few hours. looks like double-crediting across request chains.
Sam: quick repro on staging:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/econ/sim -d '{"route":"/chat/complete","chain":["svc-a","svc-b"],"prefetch":true}'
```
Sam: root cause: we attribute prefetch credit to the first owner and then later apply a cache hit refund to the same tenant, resulting in net negative adjusted cost when amortization is shallow.
Anika: UX pain: teams read "adjusted cost" and panic. Can we show both raw and adjusted side-by-side and default to raw for any negative adjusted values?
Mai: proposal: two columns (raw_token_cost, adjusted_with_cache) + small "why negative" badge that expands. also exclude canary traffic from amortized pools to avoid experiments skewing numbers.
Jordan: implementation note: we don't currently emit route lineage. minimally we can add optional fields: route_chain_ids and owner_hint as strings. but cardinality worries.
Sam: agree on optional. plan: add numeric cache_credit (can be negative) and optional route_chain_ids owner_hint. sample: '{"route":"/chat/complete","token_cost":"12","cache_credit":"-15","route_chain_ids":"svc-a|svc-b","owner_hint":"svc-a"}'.
Jordan: sampling: deterministic 5% default keyed by tenant-id, 100% for canaries/paid tiers. avoids exploding storage.
Anika: console needs an endpoint returning both series (raw/adjusted) and a toggle include/exclude cache credits. i'll mock the badge explanation and a short animation.
Mai: action items: (1) sam add optional fields + cache_credit, (2) jordan+sam implement deterministic sampling config, (3) anika UI toggle + help, (4) mai draft RFC to exclude canaries from amortization and add an alert for negative 95p > 10m.
deploy-bot: econ-service v2.13.4 deployed to staging (hash: c1a2b3f)
Sam: opening PR for schema change now. tests passing locally.
Jordan: i'll start sampling rollout plan and add telemetry to track negative-adjusted incidents.
Anika: will post UI mock in #design later today.
Mai: thanks, team. short sync in 15 if anyone wants to join. :thumbsup:
